curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify the target sounds /l/, / s/ and /r/ in an oral text

mission.title: Listen for L, S and R

interactions.retryHint: Listen for lll at the start.

interactions.prompt: Match each sound to its clue word.
interactions.retryHint: Say leaf, sun and rain slowly.

interactions.prompt: Listen in your mind: The red rabbit runs. Which sound begins red, rabbit and runs?
interactions.retryHint: Repeat red rabbit runs and hear the first sound.

interactions.prompt: Read aloud: Salma sees six stars. Which target sound repeats most?
interactions.retryHint: Listen to the start of Salma, sees, six and stars.

interactions.prompt: Read: Lila sees a red lorry. Which words begin with /l/?
interactions.retryHint: Find words beginning with the same sound as leaf.

interactions.feedback: You found l, s and r!
interactions.retryHint: Listen to the beginning of each word.
